remarks:
Welcome home to this beautifully updated, move-in-ready home that perfectly blends modern style with everyday comfort! Thoughtfully updated throughout, this inviting property offers a versatile layout, stylish finishes, and wonderful spaces to relax and entertain.

The first-floor bedroom provides added flexibility for guests, a home office, or convenient first floor living. The modern kitchen features a sink overlooking a picturesque, park-like setting, bringing a peaceful view to your everyday routine. Step outside to enjoy the screened-in porch and deck, perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or unwinding at the end of the day.

Inside, luxury vinyl flooring and tile offers both contemporary style and easy maintenance, while the spacious living room and family room provide plenty of room to gather and spread out. The gorgeous primary ensuite bathroom adds a touch of luxury to your daily routine. A partially finished, dry basement offers additional space for hobbies, recreation, storage, or a home gym.

Located in the highly desirable Williamsville School District, this home is nestled in the beautiful Audubon community, where an exceptional lifestyle awaits. Enjoy miles of scenic walking trails winding through the neighborhood and leading to a pond and lake, along with numerous playgrounds, a rentable community center, community swimming pool, tennis courts, and pickleball courts.

With its extensive updates, inviting indoor and outdoor spaces, and desirable community amenities, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. All of this, with a low quarterly HOA fee, just move in, and enjoy!

Washer and Dryer included. Showings start October 23rd. Open house November 1st from 4-6pm. Negotiations begin November 2nd at 11am.
